patch_description:
The current ansatz is overcomplex with extra ring-loop YY gates that increased parameter count (8 distinct params) and generalization gap (0.11 vs 0.04 baseline). 

Revert to the simpler prior seed structure which had:
- 7 distinct parameters (not 8)
- Better test accuracy (0.96 vs 0.89)
- Lower generalization gap (0.04 vs 0.11)
- Better worst-group margin (0.32)

This removes the redundant ring-loop YY layer (4 gates sharing 1 param) that provided no accuracy gain, and restores the elegant nearest-neighbor + cross-diagonal + long-range pattern that worked well.
